program_code='''def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    uniform_rows = {grid[r][0] for r in range(height) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1}
    uniform_cols = {grid[0][c] for c in range(width) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(height)}) == 1}
    divider_colors = uniform_rows & uniform_cols
    divider = next(iter(divider_colors))
    row_cuts = [r for r in range(height) if all(v == divider for v in grid[r])]
    col_cuts = [c for c in range(width) if all(grid[r][c] == divider for r in range(height))]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_cuts + [height]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_cuts + [width]
    blocks = []
    counts = {}
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds) - 1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri] + 1, row_bounds[ri + 1]
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds) - 1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci] + 1, col_bounds[ci + 1]
            cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
            blocks.append((r0, r1, c0, c1, cells))
            for value in cells:
                counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    marks = {v: n for v, n in counts.items() if v != background}
    marker = max(marks, key=marks.get)
    return [[1 if sum(v == marker for v in block[4]) >= 2 else background
             for block in [blocks[r * (len(col_bounds) - 1) + c]
                           for c in range(len(col_bounds) - 1)]]
            for r in range(len(row_bounds) - 1)]
'''
